title: GachaCounterHistoryExport
description: Gacha history export format for gc.chikach.net (Pity Counter)

$schema.description: Optional URL pointing to this schema. Ignored during import.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version number for forward compatibility

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the export was created

entries.description: Flat list of gacha log entries. Each entry carries its own game so a single file can hold multiple games.

remoteId.description: Unique pull ID assigned by HoYoverse

itemType.description: Item type (e.g. Character, Weapon, Light Cone)

queryGachaType.description: Canonical banner type ID used for grouping

lang.description: Language code of the stored name / itemType

time.description: Pull time in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (server-local, no timezone)
